methods.execution: Each attack explicitly selected on its imported rig. Checks clip order, stationary harmless preparation, stationary recovery, eventual completion, damage and sustained dodge. Followed by existing player-weapon contact and room-clear probe.
methods.groups: Ordinary simultaneous AI for 900 physics frames. Every member must attack. No exit before final kill, including a dormant last survivor.
methods.limits: Not visual approval or original-game authenticity. Ranges/windows and neutral cast/lob approximations need user playtesting. Bounded gate observations; not exhaustive AI state coverage.
